explication: Magisk is an Android root-management suite. The principal workflow is: a user opens the manager, selects an update or module, the app schedules or starts a download, fetches it from a release source, processes it, and presents progress or completion. The broader product also manages superuser policy, DenyList behavior, module flashing, boot-image patching, and Zygisk injection. The graph combines README capabilities with sampled implementation; several UI-to-native links remain intentionally conservative.
